## Plan

11 to 18 August 2025 with Dani and his partner Rui. Flew Lisbon to Venice Marco Polo, picked up a Fiat Panda 4x4
(Locauto, ref LCT-771204, €286 for the week), drove up to Cortina in 2h15.

## Campsites

- Camping Rocchetta Alta, near Cortina: €41 a night for two people, a tent and the Panda. Shower tokens €0.50 for
  4 minutes of hot water, buy six at once.
- Camping Seiser Hof in Val di Funes: €38 a night, flat pitches, a view of the Odle peaks straight from the tent
  door. Owner Herr Pichler brings fresh bread at 7:30 if you order the night before.

## Gear

Borrowed Rui's MSR Hubba Hubba 2. My sleeping bag is rated comfort 2°C and the nights at 1,900 m hit 3°C, so I slept
in my down jacket. The inflatable pad sprang a leak on night two; Tenacious Tape patch held for the rest of the week.
Gas canister 230 g lasted exactly five breakfasts.

## Hikes

### Tre Cime loop

Toll road up to Rifugio Auronzo, €30 per vehicle. Loop is about 10 km, took us 3h40 with stops. Windy on the north
side, clouds rolling through the gaps.

### Seceda

Gondola from Ortisei, €44 return. The ridge looks like a ramp tilted into the sky. Crowded by 10am.

### Lago di Sorapis

13 km return from Passo Tre Croci, the water is milky turquoise. Last section has cables bolted to the rock, nothing
scary but slow when there's a queue.

## Weather

Thunderstorms by 14:30 almost every afternoon. Start at 7, be back down by 2. We got caught once on the Seceda
descent, hail the size of chickpeas.

## Rifugio lunches

Rifugio Locatelli: canederli in broth €14, apple strudel €6, a radler €5. Speck on everything. Paid in cash because
the card machine "had no signal".

## Language soup

South Tyrol is German first, Italian second, Ladin in the valleys. "Grüß Gott" at every hut. My
[[German cases cheat sheet]] got more use than my Italian, which embarrassed me twice, see [[Italian false friends]].

## Hydration and cost

Long days, so electrolyte tabs in every bottle, same routine as in [[Electrolytes for long runs]]. Total per person
for the week: €612.
